about: Where a comment's code is now, for a suggestion. `range` is an anchor range (startLine, endLine, snapshot with lines, before, after); `file` is the lines of that side of the file now. `expected` is the suggested [start, end], or null for no suggestion. Passes in order: exact after trimEnd, then after trim, then (for 3 or more lines) at least 70% of lines equal after trim; the best window is the one with the highest context score, then the smallest distance from range.startLine, then the smallest start line.

cases.name: equal context and equal distance: the lower start line wins
equal context: the nearer one wins, even when it is later in the file
matching context beats distance (before and after)
matching context after the window beats distance
matching context before the window counts outward from the nearest line
a window that differs only in trailing whitespace matches in the first pass
an exact match beats a nearer trimmed match: a later pass is only tried if an earlier one found nothing
three lines with only 2 equal (67%) is not enough
four lines with 3 equal (75%) is enough
a snapshot longer than the file gives no suggestion
an empty snapshot gives no suggestion
